statements.status_notes: DHI backports upstream commit f5b7267aed3665ef025c13823e454170d031c106, nulling aliased pointers in GifMakeSavedImage before allocation to prevent double-free on malformed images. Tracker: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-23868

Alpine aports ships CVE-2025-31344.patch for giflib 5.2.2, adding a DumpScreen2RGB palette-index bounds check in gif2rgb that addresses the heap buffer overflow described in CVE-2024-45993. Tracker: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-45993
